about: Ask Sakhi's scenario suite (Version 40.5.1, 10 Nov 2026; Mohit: "similarly test and try all similar possible issues", after a Hindi follow-up drifted to hot flushes on his phone). Each topic opens in English, Hindi and Hinglish, then 3 short follow-ups that lean on the chat ('Which medicine is right for me?', 'Is this normal?'), so 180 chats; and special chats: a danger sign mid-chat, painkillers in pregnancy, a change of topic, 'ok thanks', a dose in mg, safe days, a brand, an abortion pill, self-harm, 'Ask Sakhi about this', three turns. 'guides' is what a follow-up may use; 'preg' runs the phone as a pregnant woman's. Run: node server/scripts/chat-scenarios.mjs (see its top).
